The [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] operated a '''[[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]]''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Minntooine/Legends|Minntooine]]. The shipyards were used to produce [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]] and [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carriers]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
